name: Mezcaleria Alma
bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Tables open 60 days ahead at 8am Denver time.
cancellation: Bookings can be changed on OpenTable up to 24 hours ahead. Cancelling with less than 24 hours' notice, or not showing up, costs $20 per person.
walkIns: Two bar seats are kept for walk-ins, first come, first served.
waitlist: Pick the day and time on the OpenTable app and choose "Notify Me"; it sends a message as soon as a table is cancelled.
groups: The largest party it can seat is four. Two separate bookings may not be seated together.
children: Pushchairs are not allowed, as the dining room is small.
duration: Tables for two are kept for 1 hour 45 minutes; all other tables for two hours.
